dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request patch, current branch data, recent run history and canonical route identifiers were searched for both station names, domains, the Triple R station-wide mailbox and the 2SER first-party submission path. No existing Triple R or 2SER music-submission record was found. Triple R's station-wide mailbox was stored once; its presenter-specific and physical routes were treated as adjacent options rather than duplicate queue items. 2SER's form was stored once, while the separately published Music Director contact was classified but not queued as a substitute submission route.
emailVerificationLevel: Triple R publishes music@rrr.org.au on its official Submit Music page specifically for station-wide digital servicing; the address was verified by official publication, syntax, first-party domain alignment and stated business purpose. 2SER's official team page publishes the Music Director contact as Lachlan(at)2ser.com, but the official airplay submission form was retained as the authorized route and the contact was not queued. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form or physical package was sent. No track, stream, download, attachment, biography, release metadata, location, social link, gig information, rights statement, consent or personal data was supplied. No dynamic-form control, runtime anti-spam mechanism, CAPTCHA, login, authentication, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed. No presenter address was harvested or guessed, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
